scene chikayumihallow6
And on that note, we return to the tragic tale of Maya Makinami (or the one who wears her skin).
lines.zh: 说到这里,我们回到 Makoto 真内(或者说,穿着她皮囊的那一位)的悲剧故事。

lines.en: Hurt and betrayed by the one she loves the most, the skinwalker skin-walked herself all the way over to the place she loves the most.
lines.zh: 被最爱的人伤害、背叛,皮行者一路皮行到了她最爱的地方。

lines.en: It was a random vending machine somewhere near the halfway point between the home she had and the home she wanted. But that’s not where she is right now. Right now, she’s at the shrine.
lines.zh: 那是某个自动贩卖机旁——恰好位于她拥有的家和想要的家之间的中点。但她现在不在那里。现在,她在神社。

lines.en: And she doesn’t care much for that place. She doesn’t care much for gods or sweeping. Even the miko dress she normally wore here pissed her off on days when it didn’t agree with the heat.
lines.zh: 她对那地方没什么感情。对神明、对扫地都谈不上喜欢。就连她平时在这里穿的巫女服,在不合暑气的日子里也能把她气个半死。

lines.en: But that was fine, because there was normally someone more than willing to help her take it off. Right now, though, he could be taking off some idol’s Kagome costume and she wouldn’t even know it!
lines.zh: 不过没关系,因为平时总有人非常乐意帮她把它脱下来。可现在,那人说不定正在扒哪个偶像的戈薇装,而她甚至无从知晓!

lines.en: Her blood boiled! Her hands shook! How could such a terrible thing happen to her?! But if only she knew the horrors she had already seen — and the others that have yet to befall her.
lines.zh: 她的血沸腾了!她的手发抖了!这么可怕的事怎么会发生在她身上?!可她要是知道她已经见过的恐怖——以及还没降临到她头上的那些,就好了。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue1
Into the frame walks her best friend!
lines.zh: 镜头切入,她最好的朋友登场!

lines.en: She’s a magical girl who goes by the name Ami Arakawa during the day and Sakura Sunlight at night! Her secret power was always being seven and a half steps ahead.
lines.zh: 她是一位魔法少女,白天名为 Ami Arakawa,夜里化作 Sakura Sunlight!她的秘密能力,永远是快人七步半。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
But her other secret power was cum absorption! She was almost 50%% cum now! Good job, Sakura Sunlight!
lines.zh: 但她还有另一个秘密能力:吸收精液!她现在有将近 50%% 都是精液了!干得漂亮,Sakura Sunlight!

lines.en: else:
But her other secret power was cum absorption! Just no one knew about that yet since there was no cum for her to absorb!
lines.zh: 但她还有另一个秘密能力:吸收精液!只是还没人知道,因为还没有精液可供她吸收!

lines.en: Regardless, she was here now! And she wasn’t about to let her best friend feel lonely anymore.
lines.zh: 不管怎样,她现在来了!她再也不会让挚友感到孤单。

lines.en: : Maya? Are you anywhere around here? Can you hear me?
lines.zh: : Maya?你在这附近吗?听得到我吗?

lines.en: She could! But her lips remained shut while she pictured those of a pink-haired girl slowly opening and welcoming a dick into her mouth. How lewd, this imaginary cuckoldry! Bad Maya!
lines.zh: 她听得到!但她双唇紧闭,脑中描绘着一头粉发的女孩缓缓张嘴、迎接一根东西进入口腔的画面。多么淫荡,这想象的背叛!坏 Maya!

lines.en: scene amitotherescue2
: I sure hope she’s okay...she seemed really upset back there. But at least I get where she’s coming from.
lines.zh: : 真希望她没事……她刚才看上去真的很受伤。不过至少,我懂她为什么那样。

lines.en: The hero spoke to herself. She did that a lot when she wasn’t speaking to others. Or things that she thought were there but weren’t actually there even though they were still kind of there.
lines.zh: 英雄自言自语道。她独处时经常这样。或者说,对那些她以为在场、其实并不在场,却又多少在场的「东西」说话。

lines.en: Right now, Maya Makinami actually was there, though. And sensing that Ami was just seven and a half steps away from kicking dirt into her shoes, she finally decided to speak up.
lines.zh: 不过此刻,Makoto 真内确实在场。而感觉到 Ami 的脚步距离往自己鞋里踢土只剩七步半,她终于决定开口。

lines.en: : How did you know I was here?...
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道我在这?……

lines.en: scene amitotherescue3
: Oh! There you are. I’ve been looking all over for- are you crying?
lines.zh: : 哦!你在这里。我到处在找——你在哭吗?

lines.en: : It’s...allergy season.
lines.zh: : 现在是……过敏季。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue4
: You can tell me if you are, Maya. It’s okay to cry. It’s not like I’m going to tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 如果你在哭,可以告诉我的,Maya。哭没关系。我不会告诉任何人。

lines.en: Ami Arakawa was so nice! Only a good person would say good things to a bad person. And that’s what’s happening right now! It’s a remarkable show of kindness. She’s so great!
lines.zh: Ami Arakawa 人真好!只有好人,才会对坏人说好话。而现在正在发生的就是这个!这是何等了不起的善意展示。她太棒了!

lines.en: : Why...aren’t you at the party?
lines.zh: : 你……怎么不在派对上?

lines.en: : You think I was just going to let you dramatically storm off like that without chasing after you? The party can wait. Your feelings can not.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会任由你那样戏剧性地摔门就走、不去追你吗?派对可以等。你的感受不能等。

lines.en: So kind!
lines.zh: : 好善良!

lines.en: scene amitotherescue5
: Feelings are stupid. I just thought it would be more fun to spend Halloween on my own this year. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 感受什么的很蠢。我只是觉得今年万圣节一个人过会比较有趣。就这样。

lines.en: So mean, rejecting Ami’s kindness like that! And such a liar too!
lines.zh: : 竟然这样拒绝 Ami 的好意,好过分!而且还是个大骗子!

lines.en: : And how exactly were you going to have fun at the shrine? You hate this place.
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么在神社里「玩得开心」?你讨厌这个地方。

lines.en: That’s a fact Ami Arakawa remembers because she’s a good friend who always pays attention to what the people she loves say or do.
lines.zh: 这是 Ami Arakawa 记得的事实,因为她是个好朋友,总会留心她所爱之人的言行。

lines.en: : I just...left something here. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……落了点东西在这里。就这样。

lines.en: : Well, I hope it was your honesty since you’re being a big ole liar-pants right now.
lines.zh: : 那我希望落下的是你的诚实,因为你现在就是一条彻头彻尾的骗子裤。

lines.en: Fact 1: honesty is not tangible. Fact 2: Ami Arakawa knew Maya would never find hers even if it was. Fact 3: Ami looks super cute in her costume this year! Her thighs look so soft! I bet she moisturizes!
lines.zh: 事实一:诚实摸不着。事实二:Ami Arakawa 知道,就算诚实摸得着,Maya 也永远找不到自己的那份。事实三:Ami 今年的装扮超级可爱!她的大腿看起来好软!我打赌她有认真保湿!

lines.en: : Just leave me alone, please...I’m really not in the mood today.
lines.zh: : 请让我一个人待着……我今天真的没心情。

lines.en: : I can’t just leave you alone, Maya. Not when you’re like this. What kind of friend would that make me?
lines.zh: : 我没办法放着你不管,Maya。尤其是你这副样子。那我算什么朋友?

lines.en: scene amitotherescue6
: How about...we spend Halloween together this year? Just you and me. Nobody else really wants me at the party anyway. And the people who do probably just want to beat me up.
lines.zh: : 不如……我们今年一起过万圣节?就你和我。反正派对上也没人真的想要我。而想要我的那几个,大概只想揍我。

lines.en: : No one wants to beat you up. They all just think you’re batshit insane. Hitting people like that is normally frowned upon.
lines.zh: : 没有人想揍你。他们只是觉得你彻底疯了。打你这种人,一般是会被社会舆论谴责的。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue7
: Well, at least it’s nice to know that being looked down on can have perks from time to time. But what do you say, Maya? Are you really gonna keep rejecting me? Or can we have some fun together?
lines.zh: : 好吧,至少知道被人看不起偶尔也有点好处。不过怎么样,Maya?你真的要继续拒绝我吗?还是我们可以一起玩?

lines.en: scene amitotherescue8
: Ami...did you come after me on your own? Or did...somebody put you up to this?
lines.zh: : Ami……你是自己跟来的?还是……有人让你来的?

lines.en: : Hm? That’s a weird question to ask your best friend. Why would anyone send me after you? I love you more than anybody in the world.
lines.zh: : 嗯?这话问你最好的朋友可真怪。谁会派我来找你?我是世界上最爱你的人。

lines.en: : Anybody more than Sensei, you mean.
lines.zh: : 你是说,除 Sensei 之外最爱的人。

lines.en: : He doesn’t count.
lines.zh: : 他不算。

lines.en: : Then...Niki?
lines.zh: : 那……Niki 呢?

lines.en: : You would still choose me over her, right? Just because she’s moving in doesn’t mean you don’t need me anymore, does it? Otherwise, you wouldn’t be here. Right?
lines.zh: : 你还是会选我而不是她,对吧?她搬进来不代表你不再需要我了,对吧?不然你不会在这里。对吧?

lines.en: : Maya...
lines.zh: : Maya……

lines.en: : I think we should sit down and take a break for a little while, okay?
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们该坐下来,歇一小会儿,好吗?

lines.en: scene amitotherescue9
So sit they did but break they didn’t! At least not in a bad way. Because breaking can be good sometimes! This doesn’t have to be a sad day!
lines.zh: 于是他们坐下了,但歇的却不是精神!至少不是坏意义上的那种「崩」。因为崩坏有时也可以是好事!今天不必是悲伤的一天!

lines.en: Relax and breathe and celebrate! Friendship makes the dream work. Then team work makes the other thing and...something makes the...cream...jerk.
lines.zh: 放松,呼吸,庆祝!友谊让梦想运转。然后团队合作让另一件事运转,然后……什么让……奶油……撸管。

lines.en: It’s rhyming time! It’s time to rhyme! It’s time to build a fifth ark! The third is full of bullet holes, the fourth is made of pine bark!
lines.zh: 押韵时间到!是时候押韵了!是时候建造第五艘方舟!第三艘弹孔累累,第四艘由松树皮打造!

lines.en: So anyway, just look at this. Lock eyes with screen, put dick in fist. Then squeeze until it’s purple while you wait for them to kiss!
lines.zh: 所以总之,看看这个。锁死屏幕,手握肉棒。挤压到发紫,等他们吻上!

lines.en: ABCDEFG, HIJKL. ELLENELEMENOPEE, IT’S HOT DOWN HERE IN HELL.
lines.zh: ABCDEFG,HIJKL。ELLENELEMENOPEE,地狱里真是热得慌。

lines.en: Ami is a good girl and her best friend is a bad one. She’s an uncle-stealing piece of shit who controls what Ami’s dad’s done.
lines.zh: Ami 是好女孩,她的挚友是个坏女孩。她是个偷叔叔的垃圾,操控着 Ami 爸爸做过的一切。

lines.en: Or does or did-slash-doing, these eyes don’t span for miles. Just escalators, elevators, while Ami sprints for MILES-
lines.zh: 或者做过、或者正在做,这双眼睛看不了几里远。只有扶梯和电梯,而 Ami 奔跑了数里——

lines.en: To FIND that fucking BAD GIRL she’s evil evil fuck! I hate her hate her oh my god she really really sucks!
lines.zh: 只为找到那个该死的坏女孩,她邪恶邪恶透顶!我恨她恨她,天哪她真的真的烂透了!

lines.en: Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami. Ami Ami, Ami Ami, Ami Ami Ami?
lines.zh: Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami Ami。Ami Ami,Ami Ami,Ami Ami Ami?

lines.en: The needle goes in to suck out the truth.
lines.zh: 针头刺入,抽出真相。

lines.en: : You’ve always had pretty harsh feelings when it comes to Niki, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 你提到 Niki 的时候,情绪一直很激烈,对吧?

lines.en: : I don’t know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. I know your feelings toward her and Noriko aren’t just because of a distaste for pink. You don’t like them because of how important they are to Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哦,拜托。我知道你对她和 Noriko 的敌意,不单纯是讨厌粉色。你不喜欢她们,是因为她们对 Sensei 很重要。

lines.en: : It’s the same reason you stormed out today. But that’s nothing to be embarrassed about, Maya. I get it. And honestly, it makes me feel a little weird too.
lines.zh: : 这也是你今天摔门而出的原因。但没什么好羞耻的,Maya。我懂。说实话,这让我也有点怪怪的。

lines.en: : You just gonna stay silent until I change topics? Is that what we’re doing?
lines.zh: : 你打算一直沉默到我换话题吗?我们是要这么玩吗?
: 不是……

lines.en: : I cracked and made how I really feel way too obvious today. I realize there’s no getting out of it now. But...
lines.zh: : 我破防了,今天把自己真实的心情暴露得太明显。我知道已经瞒不住了。但是……

lines.en: : What really confuses me is why you’re treating me like nothing happened instead of ripping my guts out since this is obviously more than a stupid crush.
lines.zh: : 真正让我困惑的是,为什么你当什么都没发生,而不是把我的肠子掏出来——因为很明显,这早就不只是愚蠢的暗恋了。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue10
: If I wanted to rip your guts out, I would have done it one of the other millions of times you’ve lied right to my face.
lines.zh: : 我要是想掏你的肠子,在你无数次当面撒谎里随便哪一次都干了。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue11
: Do you really think I’m that gullible? That I wouldn’t catch on to my best friend in the whole wide world fucking my uncle while I’m home sometimes? Do you really think I’m that dumb?
lines.zh: : 你真觉得我那么好骗?以为全世界最好的挚友、在我不在家的时候和我叔叔上床,我竟察觉不到?你真觉得我那么蠢?

lines.en: : I...am suddenly having second thoughts about the position I chose to have this conversation in.
lines.zh: : 我……突然对我们选择这场对话的姿势产生了第二想法。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue12
: Pfft!
: Or...not?
lines.zh: : 或者……不是?

lines.en: scene amitotherescue13
: Why did you lie to me, Maya? Why don’t you ever tell the truth?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要骗我,Maya?你为什么从来不说真话?

lines.en: : What do you mean “why did I lie?” My entire relationship with him was supposed to be confidential. And you were the last person who was ever supposed to know about it.
lines.zh: : 你说「我为什么骗你」?我和他的整段关系,本来就约定保密。而你,是最后一个有资格知道的人。

lines.en: : Because I love him more?
lines.zh: : 是因为我爱他更多?

lines.en: : Because you’re a fucking psychopath who would cut his dick off if it was the only way you knew how to keep him close to you.
lines.zh: : 因为你是个该死的精神病——如果那是你唯一知道的把他留在身边的方式,你会割下他的东西。

lines.en: : There are other ways to keep him close. And I would never intentionally hurt Sensei like that. He isn’t Sensei without his dick and I think it should stay attached.
lines.zh: : 把他留在身边的方式有很多。而且我绝不会故意那样伤害 Sensei。没有那根东西他就不是 Sensei 了,我觉得它应该留在原位。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue14
: Whatever...it’s not like it even matters anymore now that Niki’s come back into the picture. We’re both fucked. Like, what does either one of us have that she doesn’t?
lines.zh: : 随便……反正 Niki 重新登场之后,这些都无所谓了。我们俩都完蛋了。就是说,我们俩有哪一样是她没有的?

lines.en: : We’re...closer to Sensei’s preferred age group?
lines.zh: : 我们……更接近 Sensei 偏好的年龄段?

lines.en: : Yippee.
: Are you giving up then?
lines.zh: : 那你打算放弃吗?

lines.en: : I don’t want to...but it feels like he’s been trying to get me to for months now.
lines.zh: : 我不想……但感觉这几个月,他一直在试图让我放弃。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 这样啊?

lines.en: : All I’ve done lately is chase after him. And it’s made me stop and think about how all of this got started in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我最近做的所有事,就是追着他跑。这让我停下来回想,这一切当初是怎么开始的。

lines.en: : In the beginning, all we were doing was just...hiding our pain inside one another. And we worked because that worked. But if it’s not working anymore...
lines.zh: : 一开始,我们做的只是……把各自的痛苦藏进彼此身体里。我们之所以成立,是因为那样成立。可要是那样不再成立……

lines.en: : If chasing after him is only going to hurt me when it’s supposed to be making me feel better...what the fuck am I doing, Ami?
lines.zh: : 要是追着他跑只会让我受伤——明明它本该让我好受一点——那我到底在干什么,Ami?

lines.en: : Can I let you in on a little secret, Maya?
lines.zh: : 能跟你说个小秘密吗,Maya?

lines.en: : Please don’t tell me who else he’s fucking. I really don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 求你别告诉我他还在跟谁做。我真的不想知道。

lines.en: : I was just going to say that I’m worried about this Niki thing too.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说,Niki 那件事,我也很担心。

lines.en: : Bullshit. There’s no way Sensei would have let her move in without you signing off on it. All you’re doing right now is pitying me.
lines.zh: : 鬼才信。Sensei 不可能让你点头就让她搬进来。你现在只是在可怜我。

lines.en: : No, I’m telling you the truth. Scout’s honor.
lines.zh: : 不,我说的是实话。童子军荣誉担保。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue15
: Then how the fuck were you acting so composed around her earlier?
lines.zh: : 那你今天早些时候,在她面前是怎么装得那么镇定的?

lines.en: : I’m not sure if I’ve ever been “composed” a second in my life.
lines.zh: : 我不确定我这辈子有没有哪一秒钟「镇定」过。

lines.en: : Well, at least you’re aware of it. But still. The way she spoke to you alone made it feel like you two were mother and daughter. So much so that I was convinced it was just a nightmare at first.
lines.zh: : 嗯,至少你还有自知之明。但话说回来。光是单独和你说话的样子,都让你们俩像一对母女。以至于我一开始真的以为那只是场噩梦。

lines.en: : It really feels that way sometimes, doesn’t it? Like the universe is playing pranks on us...making things harder than they have to be just so somebody looking down on us can have a little fun.
lines.zh: : 有时候真的有那种感觉,对吧?像是宇宙在捉弄我们……把事情弄得比必要的更难,只为让俯视我们的某位看客取乐。

lines.en: : Bad news is there’s no one looking down on us ever.
lines.zh: : 坏消息是:永远没有人俯视我们。

lines.en: : You don’t know that for sure, Maya. No one does. So it all comes down to faith. Which is why I ask you this-
lines.zh: : 这个你也不敢打包票,Maya。谁都不敢。所以一切最终归结为信仰。所以我要问你——

lines.en: : Do you have faith in Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你信仰 Sensei 吗?

lines.en: : Do you think he’ll find his way back to you?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他会找到回到你身边的路吗?

lines.en: : I’m not really...
lines.zh: : 我真的不太……

lines.en: : Or do you want to drag him back?
lines.zh: : 还是你想把他拽回来?

lines.en: scene amitotherescue16
: D...Drag him?...
: That’s right...
lines.zh: : 没错……

lines.en: scene amitotherescue17
: If you’re tired of chasing after him, all you really need to do is keep him on a leash. That way, he won’t ever get too far away.
lines.zh: : 要是你厌倦了追着他跑,你真正需要做的,只是用链子拴住他。那样,他永远不会走太远。

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that be the answer to all of your problems?...
lines.zh: : 那不就是你所有问题的答案吗?……

lines.en: scene amitotherescue18
: Or perhaps there’s another answer? One even closer...
lines.zh: : 又或者,还有一个答案?一个更近的……
: ……Ami?

lines.en: : All this time, the three of us could have been having fun together...but you always made me wait outside.
lines.zh: : 这么多年来,我们三个本可以一起玩得很开心……可你总是让我在外面等。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue19
: W...What?
lines.zh: : 什……什么?

lines.en: : I remember the first time...I didn’t really understand what I was hearing. So I stood there with my ear up against the door for what seemed like an eternity, just...listening.
lines.zh: : 我记得第一次……我没太听懂自己听到的是什么。于是我把耳朵贴在门上,站了仿佛一个世纪那么久,只是……听。

lines.en: : You sounded so happy...I’d never heard you make noises like that before. It was almost...intoxicating. And I don’t even like girls. Or at least I didn’t think I did. But with you...
lines.zh: : 你的声音听起来那么快乐……我从没听你发出过那种声音。几乎……令人迷醉。我甚至不喜欢女孩。至少我以为我不喜欢。可是你……

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : You...
: You...listened to us?...
lines.zh: : 你……偷听过我们?……

lines.en: : Mhm...But that’s not all I did.
lines.zh: : 嗯……但那不是我做的全部。

lines.en: scene amitotherescue20
: What the fuck?...
lines.zh: : 什么鬼?……

lines.en: : Do you have any idea what it feels like to listen to your best friend and your father fuck each other’s brains out every week for years?
lines.zh: : 你知不知道那是什么感觉——听你最好的朋友和你的父亲,每周、年复一年地干到天崩地裂?

lines.en: : Because it’s annoying at first. But you start to look forward to it after a while. And you tell yourself every time, soon. Soon, they’ll remember me. Soon, they’ll let me in. Just for a peek.
lines.zh: : 一开始只是烦。但过一阵子,你开始期待。然后你每次都告诉自己:快了。快了,她们会想起我的。快了,她们会让我进去的。哪怕只看一眼。

lines.en: : And when that day never comes, you get frustrated. You start pretending you’re in there with them. You time your fingers with the creaking of the bed. Time your orgasm with theirs.
lines.zh: : 而那一天永远不来,你就开始愤怒。你开始假装自己也在里面。你把手指的动作,对准床架的吱呀声。把你的高潮,对准她们的。

lines.en: : You and I have cum together so many times and you didn’t even know it...
lines.zh: : 你和我一起去过那么多次,而你甚至不知道……

lines.en: : Isn’t that romantic, Maya?
lines.zh: : 是不是很浪漫,Maya?
: 这是……

lines.en: : Is this...
lines.zh: : 这又是……

lines.en: : Another nightmare?...
lines.zh: : 又一场噩梦吗?……

lines.en: : Is this...really happening?...
lines.zh: : 这……是真的在发生吗?……

lines.en: : That all depends on whether or not you want it to...
lines.zh: : 那就取决于你……想不想让它发生……

lines.en: scene amitotherescue21
: What’s gonna happen if Sensei really does leave you for Niki? How are you going to make yourself feel whole then?
lines.zh: : 万一 Sensei 真的为了 Niki 离开你呢?到那时,你要怎么让自己感觉完整?

lines.en: : Because I can still listen...but you’ll be all alone.
lines.zh: : 因为我还可以继续听……可你会彻底孤身一人。

lines.en: : Maybe you can still come over...and we can both play pretend.
lines.zh: : 也许你还是可以过来……我们一起玩过家家。

lines.en: : I’m a good actor, Maya. I can play a very convincing Sensei if I have to.
lines.zh: : 我的演技很好,Maya。必要的话,我可以演一个以假乱真的 Sensei。
: 或者……

lines.en: : We could do that other thing I mentioned.
lines.zh: : 我们可以做我刚才提到的另一件事。

lines.en: : We could drag him back...
lines.zh: : 我们可以把他拽回来……

lines.en: : But here’s the catch...
lines.zh: : 不过有个条件……

lines.en: : If that’s the route you want to take...It will never be only you again.
lines.zh: : 你要是选那条路……它就再也不会只有你一个。

lines.en: : Not for the rest of our lives.
lines.zh: : 在我们的余生里都不会。

lines.en: : It’ll be all three of us...
lines.zh: : 会是我们三个人……

lines.en: : Because how could anyone ever say no to that?
lines.zh: : 因为谁又能拒绝那种事呢?

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : Maya...
lines.zh: : Maya……

: I’m in.
lines.zh: : 我加入。
